text.tspan: – V1 completed: ε is the FLOOR of the per-sample weight

g.text: module: w = 1 / ( ∥dz∥² + ε ) , renormalised to unit mean
ε is the FLOOR of the weight
the knee at 1e-4 sits 2.6 decades below the median: span 3884×, ESS 0.063
the knee of 1/( x + ε ) sits at x = ε, and w ≤ 1/ε is the floor
V1 shipped one value of ε and had no way to change it
